methodology: Strict UI-only. Playwright browser. Help panel kept open during flow navigation.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: In the Blog Hub, click the Posts tab to see all your blog posts.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Click the + New Post button in the top-right corner. This opens the creation page.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: You have two options: Write from scratch opens the Blog Editor directly. Generate with AI uses AI to create a draft.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: You are now in the Blog Editor — a different screen from the Posts list. If you chose "Write from scratch", you see a blank post. Enter your Title at the top, then write your content in the rich text editor below. You can add images, links, and formatting using the toolbar.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: If you chose "Generate with AI": Enter your topic, select tone and keywords, then click Generate AI Prompt. Copy the prompt to your AI assistant, paste the JSON response, then click Save Blog Post to save and open in Blog Editor.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: In the Blog Editor, scroll down below the content area to find the metadata fields. Set your Tags (colored labels), upload a Hero Image (the main photo for your post), and write a Description (SEO) — the short summary shown in search results. These fields are all on the same page, below the editor.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Set Status to Draft, In Review, or Published. Click Save Changes.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Go to Posts and locate the post you want to translate.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Click the 🌐 translate icon next to the post. A dialog will appear.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Choose ✨ Translate with AI for automatic translation, or Translate manually to use your own tools.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: If you chose AI: the editor opens with the translated content. Review the title, description, and content for accuracy.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: If you chose manual: the editor opens with the original content. Click Translation Assistant to use the translation helper, or translate directly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Make any necessary edits to the translation. Images are automatically preserved in their original positions.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: In the Blog Editor for the translated post, check that the Slug uses words in the target language (e.g., French slugs should use French words, English slugs English words). Scroll down and update the Description (SEO) to match the translated content.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Change Status to Published when ready. Click Save Changes.
